All billing dashboard components render correctly with proper data-testid attributes

Chase button triggers API call and shows success toast

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 56 complete - Billing Command Center Dashboard verified. Key navigation: /billing-dashboard route. Backend endpoints: GET /api/billing-dashboard/metrics (returns all billing metrics), POST /api/billing-dashboard/chase/{invoice_id} (logs chase event). Frontend components: MRR/ARR card, Payment Health gauge (SVG), Cash Collection Streak (gamified), Quick Stats (6 cards), Cash Flow Forecast, Overdue Alerts table with Chase buttons, Monthly Revenue Trend chart, Top Debtors list, Recent Payments table, Invoice Pipeline. All data is real from MongoDB - no mocking.
